findings.title: Possible SQL injection (error-based) in parameter 'name'
findings.detail: A single quote caused a server error or an error-shaped response, suggesting the input reached the SQL layer unsanitized. Manually verify with Repeater before reporting.

findings.title: Reflected XSS in parameter 'q'
findings.detail: Marker '<xss-probe-b6a81143>' was reflected in the response body without HTML encoding. Any injected content here, not just this benign marker, would execute in the victim's browser.

findings.title: Broken Object-Level Authorization at /api/orders/{id}
findings.detail:
Requesting object id=1 (not owned by the authenticated user) returned 200 with body: {"id":1,"item":"Blue Widget x2","owner":"alice","total":19.98}
. Expected 403/404. Compare against the owned-object request to http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/orders/2, which correctly returned 200.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.detail: Missing: Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
